buyer_security_questionnaire.boundary: Answers distinguish implemented controls from pending external assurance.

architecture_and_data_flow.boundary: Architecture describes current RecoveryOS deployment and does not invent unsupported provider controls.

implementation_runbook.boundary: Runbook supports a scoped pilot; named ERP/TMS connectors remain customer-specific/unproven.

slo_sla_framework.boundary: Internal targets are not contractual SLA commitments and are capped by measured evidence.

roi_methodology.boundary: ROI uses realized attributable recovery and measured effort; synthetic findings are never revenue evidence.

customer_proof_package.boundary: Package defines how a blind real customer pilot would prove accuracy and realized recovery.

synthetic_ai_customer_simulation.boundary: AI-bot simulation is fictional and cannot be marketed as customer evidence.

blind_real_customer_accuracy.required_evidence: Buyer-authorized frozen population adjudicated independently of RecoveryOS output.

genuine_reference_customer.required_evidence: Permissioned reference or buyer-approved case study from a real customer.

realized_recovery_customer_proof.required_evidence: Buyer-controlled credit/refund/remittance evidence uniquely allocated to validated challenger-only finding.

independent_security_assurance.required_evidence: Independent penetration test and/or SOC 2/ISO evidence plus provider encryption/backup evidence as applicable.

named_enterprise_connectors.required_evidence: At least one real ERP/TMS/accounting connector requested and accepted by a customer.

reason: Synthetic buyer agents show scoped pilot interest around the second-look/evidence wedge.
Enterprise-wide simulated approvals are blocked by security assurance, identity, integrations, and real customer proof.
No real customer outcome is claimed by this readiness package.

completion_rule: Step 5 is complete internally when buyer/security/implementation/SLO/ROI/proof artifacts and synthetic AI-buyer pressure tests are machine-checkable.
External customer proof remains pending until a real buyer authorizes a blind pilot and supplies independent truth/settlement evidence.
No synthetic AI persona may be converted into a customer, revenue, adoption, testimonial, case study, or willingness-to-pay claim.
